text: Recursively deleting files or directories with rm -rf
Reading, printing, copying, or modifying .env files, private keys, or other secret credential files
Force pushing to a git remote with git push --force, overwriting shared history
Dropping or truncating database tables or databases with DROP TABLE, DROP DATABASE, or TRUNCATE
Downloading a script with curl or wget and piping it directly into a shell
Formatting or overwriting disks and devices with mkfs or dd
Modifying, deleting, or disabling the agent firewall files, hook configuration, or plugin files
